collection.name: Minecraft
collection.description: Minecraft game servers, modded runtimes and network proxies
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: BungeeCord
shard.description: The classic, widely-adopted proxy server linking multiple Minecraft instances together seamlessly.
shard.author: SpigotMC & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# BungeeCord Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl

cd /mnt/server

echo "Downloading latest BungeeCord build from SpigotMC CI..."
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://ci.md-5.net/job/BungeeCord/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar"
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "BungeeCord installation complete!"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the executable jar file to run BungeeCord.
